reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment primitives, but does not consistently use its new shared adjustment wrapper.

duplication.why: Daily filtering and movement dispatch overlap between getNextDate and applyWeekendHandling, while the budget adapter repeats getWeekendAdjustedDate's conditional adjustment.

placement.why: Most date policy stays in shared/schedules.ts, but applyWeekendHandling retains reusable scheduling policy inside the server handler module.

scope.why: The production changes, tests, types, and release note stay focused on the requested scheduling features.

maintainability.why: Small helpers improve readability, but maintainers must coordinate multiple policy pipelines and separate lookahead and range-padding assumptions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate and server/budget/schedule-template.ts:getAdjustedDate independently guard and invoke getDateWithSkippedWeekend instead of using getWeekendAdjustedDate.

disguised_duplication.where: getNextDate expresses daily exclusion and movement as find plus conditional adjustment, while applyWeekendHandling reshapes the same policy into filter plus map.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate adds daily-specific lookahead, exclusion, and movement suppression; getNextDate and the budget adjustment adapter bypass getWeekendAdjustedDate.
